The deck also includes a variety of tutors and card draw spells to find key pieces of the combo. The main focus of the deck is to establish a fast and aggressive tempo by utilizing a combination of spirits with flash abilities and evasive threats. Overall, the deck prioritizes maintaining control of the board and pressuring the opponent's life total in a calculated manner.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as enchantments like Wolfwillow Haven, to cast powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll early on. The deck also utilizes the devotion mechanic with cards like Polukranos Reborn and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to generate even more mana. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and efficient mana generation.

The main concept of this Pioneer 1 vs. 1 deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells, enabling the player to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and flip Thing in the Ice to its powerful side. Utilizing a mix of burn spells, card draw, and counterspells to control the game while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. The deck aims to outpace the opponent with fast, efficient plays and overwhelm them with a combination of direct damage and evasive threats. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass provides additional late-game power and card advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up green mana with cards like Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, in order to play powerful green devotion creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Polukranos Reborn. The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up green mana using creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, and then flood the board with powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Utilizing Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wolfwillow Haven, the deck aims to have a high devotion to green to gain maximum value from cards like Polukranos Reborn and Cityscape Leveler. Supporting cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provide additional card advantage and ramp, while Karn, the Great Creator helps to control the board and find key artifacts to win the match.

The primary strategy of this deck revolves around assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo, utilizing cards like Raffine's Informant and Grisly Salvage to help find key pieces. Overall, the deck aims to quickly set up the combo and overwhelm the opponent with powerful synergies.

This deck focuses on maximizing the use of Arclight Phoenix by quickly filling the graveyard with spells and then bringing it back to the battlefield for aggressive plays. It includes a mix of cheap spells, card draw, and graveyard recursion to enable consistent and explosive plays. The deck aims to put pressure on opponents early and maintain it throughout the game, leveraging the powerful Arclight Phoenix as a key threat. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Lightning Axe and Spell Pierce helps to protect the game plan and keep opponents off balance.

The main focus of the deck is to put pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful discard spells while disrupting their game plan. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill to maintain board control and eliminate threats.
